- leverages-platform: The threat actor makes use of a third-party platform or social network to spread lures or conduct fraudulent activity.
- uses-infrastructure: The threat actor utilizes a specific URL, domain, or infrastructure to carry out attacks or fraudulent activities.

Head [Threat Actor] -> Tail [Government Agency]:

Head [Threat Actor] -> Tail [Domain Name]:

Head [URL] -> Tail [(untyped)]:
